definitions.explanation: A written guide that provides instructions, procedures, or information on how to do something. Used for everything from workplace procedures to government forms.

examples.japanese: {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}を{読|よ}む。
{確定申告|かくていしんこく}の{手引|てび}き{書|しょ}をダウンロードした。
examples.english: I downloaded the tax filing guidebook.

examples.japanese: {新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}には{業務|ぎょうむ}の{手引|てび}き{書|しょ}が{配|くば}られる。
examples.english: New employees are given a work procedures manual.

notes: Compound of {手引|てび}き (guidance) + {書|しょ} (document/book). Common collocations: {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}を{作成|さくせい}する (to create a guidebook), {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}に{従|したが}う (to follow the guidebook). Similar words: マニュアル (manual, often for products or software), ガイドブック (guidebook, especially for travel), {説明書|せつめいしょ} (instruction manual). {手引|てび}き{書|しょ} has a slightly formal tone and is often used in administrative or workplace contexts.
